 (AS)

δέκατος, -η, -ον 
 (δέκα), [in LXX for מַעֲשֵׂר and cognate forms ;] 
tenth: Jhn.1:40, Act.19:9 (WH, txt., RV omit), Rev.11:13; 21:20.†
 (AS)

ἐπι-γαμβρεύω
 (γαμβρός, a connection by marriage) [in LXX: Gen.34:9, 1Ki.18:21 ff., 2Ch.18:1, Est.9:14 (חָתַן hithp.), Gen.38:8 R (יָבַם pi.), 1Ma.10:54-56 * ;] 
__1. to enter into affinity with: with dative (LXX, H. with, exc. Gen.38:8). 
 __2. to marry (as deceased husband's next of kin, cf. Gen.38:8): with accusative, Mat.22:24.†
 (AS)

θνητός, -ή, -όν
 (θνήσκω), [in LXX: Pro.3:13 20:24 (אָדָם), Job.30:23 (חַי), Isa.51:12 (מוּת), Wis.9:14 15:17, 2Ma.9:12, 3Ma.3:29 * ;] 
subject to death, mortal: Rom.6:12 8:11, 1Co.15:53-54, 2Co.4:11 5:4.†
 (AS)

ἴσος
 (epic ἶσος, so sometimes Rec.), -η, -ον, [in LXX for כְּ֜, Jb 5:14; Job.10:10, al.; אֶחָד, Eze.40:5 ff.; 2Ma.9:15, 4Ma.13:20-21, al. ;] 
equal, the same in size, number, quality, etc.: δωρεά, Act.11:17; μαρτυρίαι, Mrk.14:56, 59; ἴ. ποιεῖν, with accusative and dative, Mat.20:12; ἑαυτὸν τ. θεῷ, Jhn.5:18; τὰ ἴ. ἀπολαβεῖν, Luk.6:34, n. pl., ἴσα, adverbially, Rev.21:16; τ. θεῷ, Php.2:6.†
 (AS)

ἀλόη, -ης, ἡ 
 [in LXX: Sng.4:14 א (אֲהָלִים)* ;] 
the aloe, aloes (the powder of a fragrant wood): Jhn.19:39.†
 (AS)

Κάρπος, -ου, ὁ 
 Carpus: 2Ti.4:13.†
 (AS)

ἀμοιβή, -ῆς, ἡ
 (ἀμείβομαι, to repay); [in Aq., Sm.: Pro.12:14, al. ;] 
requital, recompense: 1Ti.5:4 (for illustration from τ.. see MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)

λεπτός, -ή, -όν
 (λέπω, to peel), 
__1. peeled. 
 __2. fine, thin, small, light; hence, in late Gk., as subst. τὸ λ., a small coin (one-eighth of an as, AV, mite): Mrk.12:42, Luk.12:59 21:2.†
 (AS)

μετοχή, -ῆς, ἡ
 (μετέχω), [in LXX: Psa.122:3 א R (חָבַר pu.) * ;] 
sharing, fellowship: 2Co.6:14.†
 (AS)

πικρῶς 
 adv. (πικρός), [in LXX for מַר, מָרַר pi. ;] 
bitterly: metaphorically, (cf. πικρὸν δάκρυον, Hom.), ἔκλαυσε π., Mat.26:75, Luk.22:62 (see MM, xviii, see word παρακολουθέω).†
 (AS)

ἀν-εύ-θετος, -ον
 (see MM, VGT, see word) 
not well placed, not fit: Act.27:12.†
 (AS)

πύρινος, -η, -ον 
 [in LXX: Eze.28:14, 16 (אֵשׁ), Sir.48:9 * ;] 
fiery: Rev.9:17.†
 (AS)

ἀντί-θεσις, -εως, ή
 (τίθημι), 
opposition: 1Ti.6:20.†
 (AS)

τάγμα, -τος, τό
 (τάσσω), [in LXX chiefly for דֶּגֶל, also for חַי, רַגְלִי ;] 
that which has been arranged or placed in order; esp. as military term, a company, troop, division, rank: metaphorically, 1Co.15:23 (see ICC, in l).†
 (AS)

ταμεῖον
 (late syncopated form of cl. ταμιεῖον; see M, Pr., 44 f.; Bl., § 6, 5; Thackeray, Gr., 63 ff.; Deiss., BS, 182 f.), -ον, τό, [in LXX chiefly for חֶדֶר ;] 
__1. a treasury (Thuc., al). 
 __2. a store-chamber (Arist., Xen.; Deu.28:8): Luk.12:24. 
 __3. an inner chamber (Xen., Hell., v, 4, 5 Isa.26:20, al.): Mat.6:6 24:26, Luk.12:3.†
 (AS)

φιλ-άγαθος, -ον 
 [in LXX: Wis.7:22 * ;] 
loving that which is good, loving goodness: Tit.1:8 (Arist., Polyb., a l.).†
 (AS)

ἀπ-αρχή, -ῆς, ἡ
 (ἀπάρχομαι, to make a beginning in sacrifice, offer first fruits) [in LXX chiefly for תְּרוּמָה, רֵאשִׁית ;] 
__1. the beginning of a sacrifice. 
 __2. first fruits: τοῦ φυράματος (cf. Num.15:20), Rom.11:16. Metaphorical, ἀ. τοῦ πνεύματος: Rom.8:23; of Christians: Rom.16:5, 1, 1Co.16:15, 2Th.2:13 (WH, mg., R, mg., txt., ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς; see Lft., Notes, 119 f.), Jas.1:18, Rev.14:4; of Christ: 1Co.15:20 15:23 (Cremer, 117; MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)

χρηματίζω
 (χρῆμα), [in LXX: Jer.26:2 29:23 30:2 36:2, 4 A (דָבַר pi.), Jer.25:30) (שָׁאַג), 3Ki.18:27, Job.40:8 * ;] 
__1. to transact business, hence, to consult, deliberate (Thuc., Dem., al.); hence in later writers, 
 __2. to make answer (esp. of offcial pronounce­ments by magistrates, etc.; in π. of the royal reply to an ἔντευξις, which see; cf. Deiss., BS, 122); of an answer by an oracle (Died., Plut., al.); in FlJ, LXX and NT, of divine communications, to instruct, admonish, warn: pass. (Bl., § 54, 3), Mat.2:22, Heb.8:5 11:7 12:25; with inf. (Bl., § 69,4; 70, 3; 72, 5), Mat.2:12, Luk.2:26, Act.10:22 
 __3. to assume a name (as in business), be called (Polyb., al.): Act.11:26, Rom.7:3 (gnomic fut.; cf. Burton, § 69).†
 (AS)

ἁπλῶς 
 adv. (ἁπλοῦς), [in LXX: Pro.10:9 (תֹּם), Wis.16:27, 2Ma.6:6 * ;] 
simply, sincerely, graciously: Jas.1:5. ("Later writers comprehend under the one word the whole magnanimous and honour­able type of character in which ... singleness of mind is the central feature "-Hort, Ja., l.with)†
 (AS)

ἀριθμός, -οῦ, ὁ 
 [in LXX chiefly for מִסְפָּר ;] 
number, a number: Luk.22:3, Jhn.6:10, Act.4:4 5:36 6:7 11:21 16:5, Rom.9:27, Rev.5:11 7:4 9:16 13:17-18 15:2 20:8 (for exx. of mystical use in π., see MM, see word).†
 (AS)

ἀσώτως 
 adv. (ἄσωτος, prodigal, wasteful), [in LXX for סָרַר, Pro.7:11 * ;] 
wastefully: Luk.15:13 
 (EV, in riotous living; but not necessarily dissolute; cf. MM, ut supr.; Milligan, NTD, 79).† (AS)
